The structure of La₂Ga₄Ni₄ (La(GaNi)₂) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/mnm (No. 15), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga centers with 9 geometric neighbors (4 Ga, 5 Ni), La centers with 16 neighbors (8 Ga, 8 Ni), and Ni centers with 11 neighbors (5 Ga, 2 La, 4 Ni). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ga and Ni coordination polyhedra.
